facts.title: What can I do with CareAround?
keywords: what can i do with carearound
facts.message: CareAround SG helps you find community Places and Programmes/services in Discover. Sign in to save resources to My Directory, create private My Maps and share a view-only snapshot, and use Care Calendar for supported saved schedules and personal plans. You can also report app problems and follow replies in Inbox. If you manage a Place, the Guide can help you draft and review a Programme/service before you choose Create. Check eligibility, fees, availability, and registration with the provider.

facts.title: Places and Programmes/services
facts.message: A Place is a physical resource such as a centre or service office. A Programme/service is an activity or support offering; it may be linked to a Place. Their schedules, audiences and access details can differ.
